name: FolioCove PDF
externalResources: Browser-managed AI summary and translation models

tools.name: Merge PDFs
tools.description: Combine multiple PDFs in the order you add them.
tools.limitations: Combine multiple PDFs in the order you add them.

tools.name: Extract pages
tools.description: Create a new PDF from only the pages you need.
tools.limitations: Create a new PDF from only the pages you need.

tools.name: Rotate PDF
tools.description: Rotate every page clockwise while keeping quality intact.
tools.limitations: Rotate every page clockwise while keeping quality intact.

tools.name: Images to PDF
tools.description: Turn JPG and PNG images into one clean PDF.
tools.limitations: One PDF page per JPG or PNG, using the image dimensions. Page order follows the selected files; margins and orientation controls are unavailable. Photo PDFs are not automatically searchable.

tools.name: Add watermark
tools.description: Stamp custom text across every page without uploading.
tools.limitations: Stamp custom text across every page without uploading.

tools.name: Add page numbers
tools.description: Add clean, centered numbering to every page.
tools.limitations: Add clean, centered numbering to every page.

tools.name: Clear PDF info fields
tools.description: Clear standard title, author, subject, keyword and software fields only. Hidden data is not removed.
tools.limitations: Clear standard title, author, subject, keyword and software fields only. Hidden data is not removed.

tools.name: Inspect PDF
tools.description: Check page count, dimensions and hidden document details.
tools.limitations: Check page count, dimensions and hidden document details.

tools.name: Quick Action
tools.description: Describe several changes once. FolioCove runs them locally in one pass.
tools.limitations: Describe several changes once. FolioCove runs them locally in one pass.

tools.name: Organize pages
tools.description: Reorder, remove or duplicate pages with one simple sequence.
tools.limitations: Reorder, remove or duplicate pages with one simple sequence.

tools.name: Crop margins
tools.description: Trim whitespace from every page by a precise percentage.
tools.limitations: Trim whitespace from every page by a precise percentage.

tools.name: Flatten forms
tools.description: Lock filled form values into the PDF for reliable sharing.
tools.limitations: Lock filled form values into the PDF for reliable sharing.

tools.name: PDF page to PNG
tools.description: Export any PDF page as a crisp, high-resolution PNG.
tools.limitations: Export any PDF page as a crisp, high-resolution PNG.

tools.name: Edit metadata
tools.description: Set the title, author and subject stored inside your PDF.
tools.limitations: Set the title, author and subject stored inside your PDF.

tools.name: Header & footer
tools.description: Add consistent document labels across every page.
tools.limitations: Add consistent document labels across every page.

tools.name: Reverse page order
tools.description: Flip the entire document from last page to first.
tools.limitations: Flip the entire document from last page to first.

tools.name: Odd / even pages
tools.description: Create a new PDF containing only odd or even pages.
tools.limitations: Create a new PDF containing only odd or even pages.

tools.name: Interleave PDFs
tools.description: Alternate pages from two PDFs—perfect for front/back scans.
tools.limitations: Alternate pages from two PDFs—perfect for front/back scans.

tools.name: Resize pages
tools.description: Fit every page cleanly onto A4 or US Letter paper.
tools.limitations: Fit every page cleanly onto A4 or US Letter paper.

tools.name: Two-up layout
tools.description: Place two document pages side by side on each sheet.
tools.limitations: Place two document pages side by side on each sheet.

tools.name: Bates numbering
tools.description: Add a prefixed, zero-padded identifier to every page.
tools.limitations: Add a prefixed, zero-padded identifier to every page.

tools.name: Compress PDF
tools.description: Shrink a PDF locally by rebuilding pages at a chosen quality.
tools.limitations: Pages become images. Text selection, forms and accessibility information are lost.

tools.name: All pages to PNG
tools.description: Export every PDF page into one convenient ZIP file.
tools.limitations: Export every PDF page into one convenient ZIP file.

tools.name: Split into chunks
tools.description: Break a long PDF into smaller PDFs inside one ZIP.
tools.limitations: Break a long PDF into smaller PDFs inside one ZIP.

tools.name: Insert blank page
tools.description: Add a blank A4 page at the end of your document.
tools.limitations: Add a blank A4 page at the end of your document.

tools.name: Extract text
tools.description: Save selectable PDF text as a clean TXT file.
tools.limitations: Save selectable PDF text as a clean TXT file.

tools.name: PDF to Markdown
tools.description: Turn selectable PDF text into page-structured Markdown.
tools.limitations: Turn selectable PDF text into page-structured Markdown.

tools.name: Reading statistics
tools.description: Count words, characters and estimated reading time locally.
tools.limitations: Count words, characters and estimated reading time locally.

tools.name: Date stamp
tools.description: Add today’s date to the bottom of every PDF page.
tools.limitations: Add today’s date to the bottom of every PDF page.

tools.name: Remove annotations
tools.description: Remove comments, links and interactive annotations from every page.
tools.limitations: Remove comments, links and interactive annotations from every page.

tools.name: Add print margins
tools.description: Place each page on a larger white canvas for safer printing.
tools.limitations: Place each page on a larger white canvas for safer printing.

tools.name: Grayscale PDF
tools.description: Create a black-and-white friendly copy for printing and archiving.
tools.limitations: Create a black-and-white friendly copy for printing and archiving.

tools.name: Find text
tools.description: Find every page containing a word or phrase without uploading.
tools.limitations: Find every page containing a word or phrase without uploading.

tools.name: Compare PDFs
tools.description: Compare page text from two PDFs and identify changed pages.
tools.limitations: Compare page text from two PDFs and identify changed pages.

tools.name: File fingerprint
tools.description: Generate a SHA-256 fingerprint to verify document integrity.
tools.limitations: Generate a SHA-256 fingerprint to verify document integrity.

tools.name: PDF to JSON
tools.description: Export page-by-page text as structured JSON for automation.
tools.limitations: Export page-by-page text as structured JSON for automation.

tools.name: Remove blank pages
tools.description: Visually detect and remove empty pages from a PDF.
tools.limitations: Visually detect and remove empty pages from a PDF.

tools.name: OCR scanned PDF
tools.description: Recognize English text from scanned pages and download it as TXT.
tools.limitations: English OCR only. Results can contain recognition errors. Large scans can exhaust browser memory.

tools.name: Enhance scanned PDF
tools.description: Increase grayscale contrast for clearer printing and reading.
tools.limitations: Increase grayscale contrast for clearer printing and reading.

tools.name: Remove headers & footers
tools.description: Cover the outer header and footer bands on every page.
tools.limitations: Covers regions with white rectangles; underlying text remains recoverable. This is NOT redaction.

tools.name: Split scanned spreads
tools.description: Turn each landscape two-page scan into separate left and right pages.
tools.limitations: Turn each landscape two-page scan into separate left and right pages.

tools.name: Edit PDF
tools.description: Place new text precisely on any page.
tools.limitations: Adds text overlays only; it does not edit existing PDF text. Standard fonts have limited language support.

tools.name: Sign PDF
tools.description: Add a typed signature and date to any page.
tools.limitations: Adds a typed visual mark only. No cryptographic signature, identity verification, signature requests or audit trail.

tools.name: Secure redact
tools.description: Permanently rasterize and black out a selected page region.
tools.limitations: Experimental raster redaction. The requested page and region are validated before output; verify the downloaded result independently before sharing sensitive material.

tools.name: Fill PDF forms
tools.description: Fill named text, checkbox and choice fields from one simple list.
tools.limitations: Fill named text, checkbox and choice fields from one simple list.

tools.name: Searchable OCR PDF
tools.description: Create a searchable scanned PDF with an invisible English text layer.
tools.limitations: English OCR only. Invisible text is not precisely aligned with the scan. Check recognition accuracy; OCR language models may need internet to load.

tools.name: Repair PDF
tools.description: Rebuild readable objects and save a clean PDF copy.
tools.limitations: Resaves PDFs the parser can already read. Severely corrupted or encrypted PDFs may fail.

tools.name: Smart summary
tools.description: Create a private extractive summary without sending text to an AI server.
tools.limitations: Extractive sentence ranking, not an AI-written summary.

tools.name: Translate PDF text
tools.description: Translate extracted text with your browser’s on-device translation engine when available.
tools.limitations: Requires the browser Translator API and supported language models; not available in every browser. English source text only; TXT output.

tools.name: HTML to PDF
tools.description: Convert an HTML or text document into a clean, printable PDF.
tools.limitations: Extracts local HTML text only; no webpage URL fetching, CSS layout or embedded images.

tools.name: Word to PDF
tools.description: Convert DOCX text into a private browser-generated PDF.
tools.limitations: DOCX text extraction only; layout, images and tables are not preserved.

tools.name: Excel to PDF
tools.description: Render spreadsheet cell values into paginated PDF tables.
tools.limitations: Exports spreadsheet cell values as text. Formatting, charts and formula layout are not preserved.

tools.name: PowerPoint to PDF
tools.description: Extract slide text and create one clean PDF page per slide.
tools.limitations: Exports slide text only; visual slide layout and graphics are not preserved.

tools.name: PDF to Word
tools.description: Export selectable PDF text as an editable Word-compatible document.
tools.limitations: Exports text as HTML in a .doc wrapper, not a native DOCX conversion. Word may show a format warning.

tools.name: PDF to Excel
tools.description: Export page text into an editable spreadsheet with one row per line.
tools.limitations: Exports text to CSV, not native XLSX or accurate table reconstruction. Spreadsheet-triggering values are prefixed as text.

tools.name: Duplicate pages
tools.description: Repeat selected pages immediately after their originals.
tools.limitations: Repeat selected pages immediately after their originals.

tools.name: Delete pages
tools.description: Remove selected pages and keep everything else.
tools.limitations: Remove selected pages and keep everything else.

tools.name: Split every N pages
tools.description: Create a ZIP containing consistently sized PDF chunks.
tools.limitations: Create a ZIP containing consistently sized PDF chunks.

tools.name: Booklet layout
tools.description: Impose pages for double-sided folding and saddle-stitch printing.
tools.limitations: Impose pages for double-sided folding and saddle-stitch printing.

tools.name: Four-up handout
tools.description: Place four document pages on each landscape sheet.
tools.limitations: Place four document pages on each landscape sheet.

tools.name: Approval stamp
tools.description: Add a dated approval, review or draft stamp to every page.
tools.limitations: Add a dated approval, review or draft stamp to every page.

tools.name: QR code stamp
tools.description: Place a scannable URL or reference code onto every page.
tools.limitations: Place a scannable URL or reference code onto every page.

tools.name: Sanitization unavailable
tools.description: Verified hidden-data removal is paused until output cleanup can be independently proven.
tools.limitations: Verified secure sanitization is currently unavailable. This tool will not create a PDF download.

tools.name: Extract contacts
tools.description: Find email addresses, phone numbers and web links in selectable text.
tools.limitations: Find email addresses, phone numbers and web links in selectable text.

tools.name: Deskew scans
tools.description: Correct a consistent small tilt across scanned pages.
tools.limitations: Correct a consistent small tilt across scanned pages.

tools.name: Visual page organizer
tools.description: Drag thumbnail pages into order, rotate them or remove them.
tools.limitations: Use thumbnail buttons to move, rotate or remove pages. Keep at least one page.

tools.name: Compress to target size
tools.description: Aim for a specific upload limit with automatic quality selection.
tools.limitations: Lossy conversion: pages become images, selectable text and forms are lost, and the target size is not guaranteed. Check readability before uploading.

tools.name: Camera document scanner
tools.description: Capture or select document photos, trim white borders and enhance contrast.
tools.limitations: Photo capture depends on your device. Trims near-white borders; does not correct perspective or detect document corners.

tools.name: Privacy Inspector
tools.description: Inspect hidden-data signals before sharing. No sanitized copy is created.
tools.limitations: Limited structural inspection, not a security audit. Sanitized sharing downloads are disabled until hidden-data removal can be independently verified.

tools.name: Workflow builder
tools.description: Combine repeatable document actions and save the recipe on this device.
tools.limitations: Saves one recipe locally on this browser. Grayscale rasterizes pages and removes searchable text.

tools.name: Sensitive data finder
tools.description: Find common personal-data patterns and permanently redact confirmed matches.
tools.limitations: Experimental pattern matching, not complete personal-data detection. False positives and missed matches are possible. Review each result independently.

tools.name: Document quality check
tools.description: Detect mixed page sizes, blank pages, low text coverage and scan-quality problems.
tools.limitations: Heuristic checks for blank pages, contrast and text coverage; not an accessibility or print-compliance audit.

tools.name: Ask PDF locally
tools.description: Find the most relevant passages for a question without uploading document text.
tools.limitations: Keyword passage retrieval, not AI reasoning or a generated answer. Results may be irrelevant.

tools.name: OpenDocument / EPUB to PDF
tools.description: Convert ODT, ODS, ODP, EPUB and RTF text into a clean PDF.
tools.limitations: Text-only experimental conversion. Layout and ebook reading order may not be preserved.

tools.name: Protect PDF
tools.description: Encrypt a PDF with an AES-256 password on this device.
tools.limitations: Encrypt a PDF with an AES-256 password on this device.

tools.name: Unlock PDF
tools.description: Remove encryption using the document password.
tools.limitations: Remove encryption using the document password.

tools.name: Lossless PDF compression
tools.description: Optimize PDF structure without rasterizing text. Size reduction varies.
tools.limitations: Optimizes PDF structure locally without turning pages into images. Size reduction is not guaranteed; keep the original and inspect the result. Modifying PDFs can invalidate digital signatures.

tools.name: Recover damaged PDF
tools.description: Attempt local cross-reference and object recovery. Some damaged files cannot be recovered.
tools.limitations: Attempt local cross-reference and object recovery. Some damaged files cannot be recovered.

tools.name: PDF to JPG
tools.description: Export each page as a JPG in a ZIP file.
tools.limitations: Renders every PDF page into a JPG and downloads them together as a ZIP. This does not extract the original embedded images. Inspect image readability; large pages may exceed rendering limits.

tools.name: PDF to Word (DOCX)
tools.description: Export selectable text into an editable DOCX. Original layouts and images are not preserved.
tools.limitations: Exports selectable PDF text to native DOCX paragraphs. Original layout, tables and images are not preserved; scans need English OCR first.

tools.name: PDF to Excel (XLSX)
tools.description: Export extracted text rows into a real workbook, one sheet per page. Table reconstruction is approximate.
tools.limitations: Export extracted text rows into a real workbook, one sheet per page. Table reconstruction is approximate.

tools.name: PDF to PowerPoint
tools.description: Preserve each page visually as a slide image. Slide content is not editable.
tools.limitations: Preserve each page visually as a slide image. Slide content is not editable.

tools.name: Create PDF forms
tools.description: Add a named text field, checkbox, dropdown, or radio group to a PDF. Existing form fields are preserved.
tools.limitations: Add a named text field, checkbox, dropdown, or radio group to a PDF. Existing form fields are preserved.

tools.name: Draw signature / freehand
tools.description: Draw an ink signature or annotation and place it on a page. This is a visual mark, not a digital certificate.
tools.limitations: Draw an ink signature or annotation and place it on a page. This is a visual mark, not a digital certificate.

tools.name: Image watermark
tools.description: Place a PNG or JPG watermark on every PDF page.
tools.limitations: Place a PNG or JPG watermark on every PDF page.

tools.name: Add PDF shapes
tools.description: Add a colored rectangle, ellipse, or line to a page.
tools.limitations: Add a colored rectangle, ellipse, or line to a page.

tools.name: Compare PDFs visually
tools.description: View corresponding pages side by side locally. This does not automatically identify every difference.
tools.limitations: View corresponding pages side by side locally. This does not automatically identify every difference.

tools.name: AI Summarizer
tools.description: Summarize selectable text using the browser’s on-device AI, when supported. A model download may be required.
tools.limitations: Browser-dependent on-device AI. Requires a supported browser and available English model; a model download may be needed. If unavailable, use Smart summary instead.
